$comment: scripts/run-tests.js spawns one mocha process PER TEST FILE. Those children
inherit NODE_V8_COVERAGE, so each writes its own V8 profile into temp-directory
and c8 merges all of them into a single report.
`clean` is false on purpose: coverage.js empties temp-directory itself before
the run and then renders with `c8 report`, which must NOT wipe what it reads.
`all: true` makes never-required files report 0% instead of vanishing.
Exclusions. Each needs a reason; being badly covered is NOT one. The AI
directives, the Mongo data sources and the routes are the real gap and stay in.
tybotRoute/test/**                  the tests are the instrument, not the subject
tybotRoute/scripts/**               the test runner and this coverage wrapper, same reason
tybotRoute/types/**                 pure JSDoc typedefs, no runtime code to execute
tybotRoute/routes/legacyHelpers.js  dead code, moved verbatim, zero callers
tybotRoute/logs/**, uploads/**      runtime output directories, not source
node_modules is excluded by c8's own default.
